quote: the common term for a supposed race of supernatural beings who magically intermeddle in human affairs.

statement.id: Fairy adalah istilah bagi makhluk gaib yang dalam cerita turut campur secara ajaib dalam urusan manusia.
statement.en: Fairy refers to supernatural beings said to interfere magically in human affairs.

quote: Discover the intriguing, formidable faeries of old British and Irish folk narratives.

statement.id: Fairy tampil dalam cerita rakyat lama Britania dan Irlandia.
statement.en: Fairies appear in old British and Irish folk narratives.

quote: Split between numerous local species, ranging from full-sized Scottish elf-queens to small, wizened male house fairies, they share a number of common characteristics.

statement.id: Fairy terbagi dalam banyak jenis lokal, dari ratu elf Skotlandia berukuran penuh sampai peri rumah laki-laki yang kecil dan keriput.
statement.en: Fairies are split between numerous local species, from full-sized Scottish elf-queens to small, wizened male house fairies.

quote: All are immortal, with supernatural powers that include vanishing, shape-shifting and creating illusions.

statement.id: Dalam cerita Britania dan Irlandia, fairy bersifat abadi dan dapat menghilang, berubah wujud, atau menciptakan ilusi.
statement.en: In British and Irish tales, fairies are immortal and can vanish, shapeshift, or create illusions.

quote: They are typically capricious, dangerous and vengeful, though may display benevolence so long as great care is taken not to offend them by breaking their curious protocols.

statement.id: Fairy dapat berbahaya atau baik hati tergantung perlakuan manusia dalam cerita.
statement.en: Fairies may be dangerous or benevolent depending on human conduct in stories.

quote: They carry off children, leaving changeling substitutes, transport men and women into fairyland

statement.id: Cerita fairy memuat penculikan anak dan penggantian dengan changeling.
statement.en: Fairy stories include child abduction and changeling substitution.

quote: Though some can fly, they do not have wings, but levitate by mounting twigs, bundles of grass or plant stems, wearing a special cap or uttering a set of potent words.

statement.id: Dalam cerita lama, sebagian fairy terbang tanpa sayap.
statement.en: In older stories some fairies fly without wings.

quote: fairy lore has provided a fruitful area of investigation for contributors to the journal Folklore since its founding in the late nineteenth century.

statement.id: Cerita fairy telah diteliti dalam jurnal Folklore sejak akhir abad ke-19.
statement.en: Fairy lore has been studied in Folklore since the late nineteenth century.

quote: The “people of peace” (Daoine Shie) of Ireland and Scotland are usually of ordinary stature, indeed not to be recognized as varying from mankind except by their proceedings

statement.id: Daoine Shie ("people of peace") Irlandia dan Skotlandia biasanya berukuran biasa dan tidak dapat dibedakan dari manusia kecuali dari tindakan mereka.
statement.en: The "people of peace" (Daoine Shie) of Ireland and Scotland are usually of ordinary stature and not recognisable as differing from mankind except by their proceedings.

quote: Med. Lat. fatare, to enchant, from Lat. fatum, fate, destiny

statement.id: Britannica 1911 menelusuri kata fairy (dan padanannya fée, fada, hada, fata) ke bahasa Latin Abad Pertengahan fatare, "memikat", dari Latin fatum, nasib.
statement.en: The 1911 Britannica traces the word fairy (and its cognates fée, fada, hada, fata) to Medieval Latin fatare, "to enchant", from Latin fatum, fate or destiny.

quote: Of all the minor creatures of mythology the Fairies are the most beautiful, the most numerous, the most memorable in literature.

statement.id: Andrew Lang menilai fairy sebagai makhluk kecil mitologi yang paling indah, paling banyak, dan paling berkesan dalam sastra.
statement.en: Andrew Lang judges fairies the most beautiful, most numerous and most memorable in literature of the minor creatures of mythology.

quote: Here they dwell in the "raths," old earth-forts, or earthen bases of later palisaded dwellings of the Norman period, and in the subterranean houses, common also in Scotland.

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan Irlandia, fairy tinggal di "raths", benteng tanah tua, dan di rumah bawah tanah yang juga umum di Skotlandia.
statement.en: In Irish belief, fairies dwell in the "raths", old earth-forts, and in subterranean houses, which are also common in Scotland.

quote: They are an organized people, often called "the army," and their life corresponds to human life in all particulars.

statement.id: Fairy Irlandia digambarkan sebagai bangsa yang terorganisasi, sering disebut "pasukan", dengan kehidupan yang sejajar dengan kehidupan manusia dalam segala hal.
statement.en: Irish fairies are described as an organized people, often called "the army", whose life corresponds to human life in all particulars.

quote: a living human being must not eat in Fairyland; if he does, he dwells there for ever.

statement.id: Manusia hidup tidak boleh makan di negeri peri; jika makan, ia tinggal di sana selamanya.
statement.en: A living human being must not eat in Fairyland; if he does, he dwells there for ever.

quote: The neighbours said that the Fairies caused the phenomenon, as the man had swept his chimney with a bough of holly, and the holly is "a gentle tree," dear to the Fairies.

statement.id: Dalam satu laporan, tetangga menyebut fairy menyebabkan lemparan batu karena si pemilik rumah menyapu cerobong dengan ranting holly, pohon "lembut" yang disayangi fairy.
statement.en: In one report, neighbours said fairies caused flying stones because the man had swept his chimney with a bough of holly, "a gentle tree" dear to the fairies.

quote: In Ireland and the West Highlands Neolithic arrow-heads and flint chips are still fairy weapons.

statement.id: Di Irlandia dan Dataran Tinggi Barat, mata panah Neolitik dan serpihan batu api masih dianggap senjata fairy.
statement.en: In Ireland and the West Highlands, Neolithic arrow-heads and flint chips are still regarded as fairy weapons.

quote: the nearest analogy to the shape which it takes in Scotland and Ireland—the "pixies" of south-western England—is to be found in Jān or Jinnis of the Arabs, Moors and people of Palestine.

statement.id: Lang menulis bahwa padanan terdekat bentuk kepercayaan ini di Skotlandia dan Irlandia, serta "pixies" Inggris barat daya, ada pada jān atau jin orang Arab, Moor, dan Palestina.
statement.en: Lang writes that the nearest analogy to the form of the belief in Scotland and Ireland, and the "pixies" of south-western England, is found in the jān or jinn of Arabs, Moors and people of Palestine.

quote: It is plain that Fairies and Jān are practically identical

statement.id: Lang menyimpulkan bahwa fairy dan jān praktis identik.
statement.en: Lang concludes that fairies and jān are practically identical.

quote: Fairies naturally won their way into the poetry of the Middle Ages. They take lovers from among men, and are often described as of delicate, unearthly, ravishing beauty.

statement.id: Fairy masuk ke puisi Abad Pertengahan; mereka mengambil kekasih dari kalangan manusia dan sering dilukiskan sangat indah dan tak berbau duniawi.
statement.en: Fairies entered the poetry of the Middle Ages; they take lovers from among men and are often described as delicately, unearthly beautiful.

quote: as in the notable tale of Melusine. This fay by enchantment built the Castle of Lusignan for her husband. It was her nature to take every week the form of a serpent from the waist below.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Melusine, fay itu membangun Kastil Lusignan dengan sihir untuk suaminya dan setiap pekan berubah menjadi ular dari pinggang ke bawah.
statement.en: In the tale of Melusine, the fay built the Castle of Lusignan by enchantment for her husband and each week took the form of a serpent from the waist down.

quote: There seems little in the characteristics of these Fairies of romance to distinguish them from human beings, except their supernatural knowledge and power. They are not often represented as diminutive in stature

statement.id: Fairy dalam roman Abad Pertengahan sedikit berbeda dari manusia kecuali pengetahuan dan kekuatan gaibnya, dan jarang digambarkan bertubuh kecil.
statement.en: The fairies of medieval romance differ little from human beings except in supernatural knowledge and power, and are not often shown as diminutive.

quote: The fairy women who come to the births of children and foretell their fortunes

statement.id: Lang menyebut adanya perempuan fairy yang datang pada kelahiran anak dan meramalkan nasibnya.
statement.en: Lang mentions fairy women who come to the births of children and foretell their fortunes.

quote: It is a not uncommon theory that the Fairies survive in legend from prehistoric memories of a pigmy people dwelling in the subterranean earth-houses, but the contents of these do not indicate an age prior to the close of the Roman occupation of Britain

statement.id: Lang menyebut teori bahwa fairy berasal dari ingatan prasejarah tentang bangsa kerdil penghuni rumah bawah tanah, tetapi isi rumah-rumah itu tidak menunjukkan zaman sebelum berakhirnya pendudukan Romawi di Britania.
statement.en: Lang mentions the theory that fairies survive from prehistoric memories of a pigmy people in subterranean earth-houses, but notes the contents of these do not point to an age before the close of the Roman occupation of Britain.

quote: Gervaise of Tilbury, writing early in the 13th century, has in his Otia Imperialia a chapter, De lamiis et nocturnis larvis, where he gives it out, as proved by individuals beyond all exception, that men have been lovers of beings of this kind whom they call fadas

statement.id: Gervaise dari Tilbury, menulis pada awal abad ke-13 dalam Otia Imperialia, menyatakan bahwa ada manusia yang menjadi kekasih makhluk yang mereka sebut fadas.
statement.en: Gervaise of Tilbury, writing in the early 13th century in his Otia Imperialia, reports that men have been lovers of beings they call fadas.

quote: The first, beings of the human race, but endowed with powers beyond those usually allotted to men, whom we shall term Fays, or Fairies of Romance.

statement.id: Keightley membagi makhluk bernama fairy menjadi dua golongan; golongan pertama adalah makhluk dari ras manusia dengan kekuatan melampaui manusia biasa, yang disebutnya fays atau fairy roman.
statement.en: Keightley divides the beings called fairies into two classes; the first are beings of the human race endowed with powers beyond those usually allotted to men, whom he terms fays, or fairies of romance.

quote: The second, those little beings of the popular creeds, whose descent we propose to trace from the cunning and ingenious Duergar or Dwarfs of Northern Mythology, and whom we shall denominate Elves or popular Fairies.

statement.id: Golongan kedua menurut Keightley adalah makhluk kecil dalam kepercayaan rakyat, yang ia usulkan berasal dari Duergar atau kurcaci mitologi Nordik, dan disebutnya elf atau fairy rakyat.
statement.en: The second class, in Keightley's scheme, are the little beings of popular creeds, whose descent he proposes to trace from the Duergar or dwarfs of Northern mythology, and whom he calls elves or popular fairies.

quote: The root is evidently, we think, the Latin fatum.

statement.id: Keightley menyimpulkan bahwa akar kata fée, fada, hada, dan fata dalam bahasa-bahasa Roman adalah kata Latin fatum.
statement.en: Keightley concludes that the root of the Romance words fée, fada, hada and fata is the Latin fatum.

quote: no theory is so plausible, or is supported by such names, as that which deduces the English fairy from the Persian peri.

statement.id: Keightley menulis bahwa tidak ada teori yang sepopuler atau sekuat dukungan nama-namanya seperti yang menurunkan kata Inggris fairy dari peri Persia.
statement.en: Keightley writes that no theory is so plausible, or supported by such names, as the one deriving English fairy from Persian peri.

quote: the word came to signify the individual denizen of Fairy-land, and was equally applied to the full-sized fairy knights and ladies of romance, and to the pygmy elves that haunt the woods and dells.

statement.id: Kata fairy akhirnya berarti penghuni negeri peri secara individual, dan dipakai baik untuk ksatria serta putri fairy berukuran penuh dalam roman maupun elf kerdil yang menghuni hutan dan lembah.
statement.en: The word came to mean the individual inhabitant of Fairy-land, applied both to the full-sized fairy knights and ladies of romance and to the pygmy elves of woods and dells.

quote: They generally excel mankind in power and in knowledge, and like them are subject to the inevitable laws of death, though after a more prolonged period of existence.
locator: Origin of the belief in fairies

statement.id: Keightley menulis bahwa makhluk-makhluk semacam ini umumnya melebihi manusia dalam kekuatan dan pengetahuan, dan seperti manusia tunduk pada kematian, meski setelah umur yang lebih panjang.
statement.en: Keightley writes that such beings generally excel mankind in power and knowledge and, like humans, are subject to death, though after a longer span of existence.

quote: After the appearance of the Faerie Queene, all distinctions were confounded, the name and attributes of the real Fays or Fairies of romance were completely transferred to the little beings

statement.id: Keightley menulis bahwa setelah terbitnya Faerie Queene, semua pembedaan menjadi kabur dan nama serta sifat fay roman dialihkan sepenuhnya kepada makhluk-makhluk kecil.
statement.en: Keightley writes that after the appearance of the Faerie Queene all distinctions were confounded and the name and attributes of the fays of romance were transferred to the little beings.

quote: The herb rue is potent against them, as in British folk-lore

statement.id: Lang menulis bahwa tanaman rue ampuh melawan jān, seperti dalam cerita rakyat Britania.
statement.en: Lang writes that the herb rue is potent against the jān, as in British folk-lore.
